description: TigerSheets native workbook read/search, financial modeling, native reporting and isolated preview tool contract. Accept and save remain user actions.

tools.description: Discover built-in native workbook editing tools, exact operation schemas, limits and financial-model/chart examples. Call before preparing workbook edits; no external skill, file access or installation is needed.
tools.name: workbook_v1_capabilities

tools.description: Read bounded native cells and workbook metadata, including charts. During a proposal this reads the pending preview; revision remains the live base for later preview calls. Coordinates and rectangles are 1-based and inclusive. At most 10000 cells/1 MiB cell JSON; each metadata value is limited to 256 KiB. metadataTruncated names omitted fields, which cannot be replaced.
tools.name: workbook_v1_read

tools.description: Search live or pending preview cell inputs for text. Returns stable worksheet ids, cell coordinates, the live base revision and up to 1000 matches.
tools.name: workbook_v1_search

tools.description: Read a native report slice within 1 MiB, including its complete editable definition (at most 256 KiB). Oversized definitions refuse safely; use bounded member reads to inspect large selections. Reads the pending proposal and never returns source records.
tools.name: workbook_v1_report

tools.description: List up to 200 native report summaries, including preserved read-only imports. Returns stable ids, locations and field names without source records or member caches.
tools.name: workbook_v1_reports

tools.description: Search a report's retained source-field members. Returns up to 200 typed items and at most 1 MiB, with selection and missing-item state. Query searches the whole field cache; offset paginates matching members. Reads the pending proposal when present.
tools.name: workbook_v1_pivot_members

tools.description: List up to200 financial model summaries from the live or proposed workbook, optionally filtering by kind. Generated results and source caches are omitted; unsupported versions remain read-only.
tools.name: workbook_v1_financial_models

tools.description: Read one complete editable financial setup, at most256 KiB. Generated results, provenance and caches are omitted. Unsupported definitions return bounded read-only identities.
tools.name: workbook_v1_financial_model

tools.description: Create or extend one isolated, revision-checked native workbook proposal. When asked to create/edit a model or chart, use this tool to do it. set_range writes financial data/formulas; add_chart appends an editable chart. Consecutive calls at the same live revision accumulate in one proposal. Only the user can accept/discard it; saving remains a desktop action.

oneOf.description: Set one Excel input string. Formulas begin with =; a leading apostrophe forces literal text. Optional style merges unless replaceStyle is true.

Write a nonempty rectangular matrix from the 1-based top-left cell. Text uses Excel input syntax, numbers are decimal, booleans TRUE/FALSE and null clears input. Maximum 10000 cells across the complete preview.
Style one cell, merging with its current style unless replace is true. Colors use #RRGGBB; numberFormat uses Excel format syntax.
Create a worksheet with a new stable id. Later operations in this preview can address that id.
Rename an existing worksheet; supported local formula references update automatically.
Clear inputs in a bounded inclusive rectangle while retaining formatting; at most 10000 addressed cells per preview.
Append an editable native chart with a unique id while preserving every existing chart. Provide a table with categories in its first column and series headings in its first row.

range.description: The first row contains series headings; the first column contains categories. At least 2 rows and 2 columns; at most 10000 data rows and 100 series.

oneOf.description: Replace one supported workbook metadata field. Read its existing value first. Unrelated fields remain preserved. Macro enablement is a desktop action; VBA source proposals cannot enable macros.

value.description: Replace the complete named metadata value. Prefer add_chart for insertion. charts is an array of the chart schema; names is an object mapping names to reference strings; vba is an object with modules [{name,source}], existing project metadata and user enablement are retained, and enabling macros is unavailable. Other keys preserve their native workbook JSON format.

oneOf.description: Create a real native PivotTable from a local rectangular source. Headers must be unique text. Cache and generated output are owned; use typed report operations to edit. Up to100000 records/1million data cells,4measures and250000 output cells.
Update editable fields, filters, measures or source of an existing native pivot; recompute its cache, owned output and linked charts in the same proposal.
Recalculate an existing native pivot from the proposed source, replacing its cache and generated output together. An unchanged refresh produces no edit.
Relocate a native pivot using its retained cache and preserving stale state. Generated cells and linked charts move together; supported dependent formulas and defined names follow the move.
Delete an editable native pivot, its generated output and its linked PivotCharts together. Source data is retained.
Create a genuine native PivotChart linked to a proposed/existing pivot; series follow its fields and filters and exclude grand totals. Maximum1000categories/16series.
Update the family, title or position of an existing editable PivotChart, retaining its owning report.
Delete an editable PivotChart while retaining its source PivotTable.
Save a validated assumption set, scenario, Goal Seek or Solver setup in the isolated proposal. Saving never applies inputs or accepts a numerical solution.

Run exactly one new editable definition or saved model id using the frozen calculation context. Builds a forecast/comparison/sensitivity report, applies saved inputs, or offers only a qualified Goal Seek/Solver solution. The result remains an isolated proposal for user review.
Apply a saved assumption set or scenario to its validated constant input cells in the proposal, preserving formulas and generated report ownership.
Delete an editable saved model and its generated owned output together. Dependent models must be removed first; source model inputs are retained.

tools.name: workbook_v1_preview
